{{Top|leg}}
'''Leso''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Commenting on the [[Ubese raider armor]], Leso noted that replacing the filter on the [[enviro filter]] to accept a [[Atmosphere/Legends|Type I atmosphere]] was virtually impossible.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
